name: EPGForgearr
description: Supplemental XMLTV EPG generator for Dispatcharr. Workflow: scan missing EPG, review suggestions, generate XMLTV, install Dispatcharr EPG source.
author: Mildman1848

fields.label: Days to generate
fields.help_text: Number of EPG days to fetch.

fields.label: Output XMLTV path
fields.help_text: XMLTV output path inside Dispatcharr container.

fields.label: Suggestions review path
fields.help_text: Scan output file. Edit selected/chosen_candidate here before exporting the mapping.

fields.label: Selected mapping path
fields.help_text: Reviewed mapping JSON used for XMLTV generation.

fields.label: Full EPG provider
fields.help_text: Provider used by Generate full provider EPG (single-provider actions). Generate all provider EPG sources ignores this and covers every usable provider.

fields.label: Minimum suggestion confidence
fields.help_text: Use low only for review reports. Low confidence is not safe for automatic activation.

fields.label: Also scan channels that already have EPG
fields.help_text: Normally off: supplemental EPG should target gaps first.

fields.label: Auto-select safe-looking suggestions
fields.help_text: Leave off for real use. Suggestions are review material; variants can look deceptively exact.

fields.label: Dispatcharr EPG source name
fields.help_text: Name of the managed Dispatcharr EPGSource.

fields.label: Activate EPG source after install
fields.help_text: Create/update the EPG source as active. Keep off for dry production staging.

fields.label: EPG source priority
fields.help_text: Dispatcharr source priority. Higher/lower semantics depend on Dispatcharr; keep supplemental conservative.

fields.label: Inline channel/source mapping JSON
fields.help_text: Advanced/manual path for generate_epg legacy action. Prefer suggestions_path + mapping_path workflow.

fields.label: Daily auto-refresh
fields.help_text: Regenerate the full provider EPG daily in the background (Celery worker self-scheduler).

actions.label: Scan missing EPG
actions.description: Scan Kodiboxarr-linked Dispatcharr channels and write reviewable provider suggestions.

actions.label: Export selected mapping
actions.description: Convert reviewed suggestions to mapping.selected.json. Only selected suggestions are exported.

actions.label: Validate inline mapping
actions.description: Validate configured inline channel/source mapping without fetching EPG.

actions.label: Generate XMLTV from selected mapping
actions.description: Fetch provider data from mapping.selected.json and write XMLTV output.

actions.label: Generate full provider EPG
actions.description: Download all channels/programmes from the selected provider and write a complete XMLTV file.

actions.label: Install Dispatcharr EPG source
actions.description: Create/update the managed Dispatcharr EPGSource for the generated XMLTV file.

actions.label: Generate full EPG and install
actions.description: Download the full provider EPG and create/update the Dispatcharr EPGSource.

actions.label: Generate and install
actions.description: Generate XMLTV from selected mapping and create/update Dispatcharr EPGSource.

actions.label: Generate all provider EPG sources
actions.description: Download the full EPG for every usable provider (Magenta, TV Digital DE, ...) and create/update one separate Dispatcharr EPGSource per provider. Skips providers that are only planned (e.g. SimpliTV).

actions.label: Scheduler status
actions.description: Show last/next scheduled full refresh state (daily self-refresh).
